property_summary: The reference contract C allows only the Owner to call Command (calls from Owner always succeed); the mutant inverts the check so non-owners can call Command, so there exist inputs (an Owner caller) for which the reference accepts but the mutant rejects (or vice versa) — we assert that when msg.sender == Owner, calling Command succeeds on the reference for all inputs.
change_summary: Invert the ownership check so only non-owners can execute Command, changing which caller can invoke it and thus observable behavior.
